title: University Forum in Argentina - Powered by Cardano

ms.promise:
・Project charter, governance model, and delivery timeline aligned to academic calendars — includes explicit decision paths, escalation rules, and an active risk log.
・Work Tables 2.0 framework with 10 potential themes / subjects in catalogue form (Specific and final subjects for said work tables will be determined in collaboration with a greater amount of university partners that will be available by Milestone 1, this is imperative because the subjects covered need to be aligned with their interests) with facilitator guide and an integration-brief template set (theme catalogue).
・Expert panel taxonomy + and short-list of potential speakers.
・Standards & privacy brief referencing the specified CIPs (CIP-25, CIP-68, CIP-30, CIP-8) and data-minimization boundaries (on/off-chain).
・Brand system v1 and a complete performance marketing plan (UTM conventions + weekly cadence); analytics baseline/dashboard skeleton online.
・﻿University participation confirmations: target faculties with named contacts and written confirmations from at least eight universities.
